Description: AD Directory Service Object Access with Replication Rights
Finding: Active Directory object access events were detected containing replication extended rights GUIDs. This pattern is consistent with a DCSync attack, where an attacker abuses the DRSUAPI replication protocol to extract NTLM password hashes and Kerberos keys for domain accounts without requiring physical access to a Domain Controller.
ImmediateAction: Isolate any non-DC host or account that triggered this event.; Reset the krbtgt account password twice in succession to invalidate any Golden Tickets.; Force immediate password reset for all Domain Admin and Enterprise Admin accounts.
FollowUp: Audit all accounts holding the Replicating Directory Changes All extended right using Get-ADUser with ACL inspection.; Review Domain Controller Security logs for additional 4662 events with Properties GUIDs 1131f6ad-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2 or 19195a5b-6da0-11d0-afd3-00c04fd930c9.; Investigate for Golden Ticket usage. Look for anomalous Kerberos TGT lifetimes or logins from unexpected hosts.; Escalate to senior security staff. DCSync from a non-DC account indicates full domain compromise.
